_comment: Committed template. Real addresses go in config.local.json, which is gitignored and merged over this file key by key. Private keys never appear in either: they live at keysPath, default ~/.phosphor/keys.json, outside the working copy.
_skills: Which files in skills/ a connecting agent is told to use. Names only, no .md. Everything in skills/ is installed; only what is listed here is live. Empty means the agent runs on the connect-time rules alone.
